sections.text: Introduction

This document outlines the 
feeders protection testing procedure P1 witch must be performed on an annually 
basses as 
indicated by Y1 in the above title block

The first draft initiated by eng. Mohamed Aly 
Aly Hassan. tested by eng. Al-Shahat 
Ahmed Mousa. At 7 sep. 2003, revised by EDEPC quality control engineer. Adel 
El-Nagar, accepted by general director eng. Hamdy Abd el-Moola Melegy, approved 
by Yousry Mohamed Aly Salama: Power Station head sector, and 
certified by EDEPCo. Quality 
Control Head Sector eng. Aly Al Lethy.
The Protection Scheme consists of:

Static over current relay - 
IKS 703 (F1) No (1,2)(3,4)(5,6)

Directional earth fault relay - PM 2g no/90 (F3) No (1,2) C.T and (3,4) 
V.T
Zero sequence current relay - IM 3X - SSX 110 (F6) No (1,2) C.T

sections.text: Work to be Carried Out

items: Connect the relay testing units (Sverker) to a power source

Connect the timer to power source and its terminals to the 
 trip terminals the relay test

Put an ammeter on current leads of testing unit to measure the 
 current and connect the voltmeter in parallel with the voltage leads testing 
 unit to measure the voltage
Review the manual
Prepare the previous results of the relay testing
Be sure that the CB disconnected and DC source is available
